description: MMIR.ai feature catalog for plus-style expandable homepage sections. MMIR is the orchestration layer for trusted AI; all items are safe frontend descriptions only.

features.title: Connect Model
features.headline: Open MMIR, connect local AI, install, ready.
features.description: Start by connecting a local connector, trusted backend or self-managed model endpoint through the MMIR control plane. Paid SaaS routes stay behind protected backend policy.
bullets: start chatting from the control plane

features.title: Local AI Connector
features.headline: Run your own AI locally, securely and privately.
features.description: Connect local LLMs on your own machine with guided onboarding. MMIR will detect your local node, list available models and route chat through a controlled connector instead of exposing raw runtimes to the internet.
bullets: run AI privately on your own hardware

features.title: Multi-Model Chat
features.headline: Model-agnostic orchestration for every AI system you trust.
features.description: Connect and use multiple local, cloud and SaaS AI models from one unified control plane. Switch between models, compare answers and route tasks to the best AI for the job.
bullets: orchestrate many AI models in one place

features.title: Intelligent Workflow Orchestration
features.headline: Workflows are the moat above chat.
features.description: Combine models, instructions, memory, policy and tools into reusable AI pipelines for research, coding, analysis, summarization and decision support.
bullets: combine reasoning from multiple AI systems

features.title: Local + Cloud AI Integration
features.headline: Use local privacy and cloud scale together.
features.description: Connect local LLMs, private VMs, Open WebUI, Ollama, SaaS APIs and future cloud runtimes through one trusted orchestration layer.
bullets: combine private/local AI with powerful cloud models

features.title: Trusted AI Routing
features.headline: Route tasks to the right intelligence automatically.
features.description: Route prompts and workflows to the best available model, backend or compute environment based on performance, trust level, policy, cost and user preferences.
bullets: better use of hardware and cloud resources

features.title: Knowledge & RAG Integration
features.headline: AI that understands your own data.
features.description: Upload files, connect repositories and attach knowledge sources so MMIR can provide contextual answers using your own information.
bullets: connect GitHub and future data sources
ask questions about your own information

features.title: Persistent AI Memory
features.headline: AI that evolves with you over time.
features.description: Remember workflows, preferences, projects and context so MMIR becomes persistent intelligence instead of stateless prompts.

features.title: Fine-Tuning & Model Adaptation
features.headline: Customize AI for your workflows and domain.
features.description: Future functionality can support lightweight fine-tuning, LoRA adapters and custom model specialization without requiring full-scale model training.

features.title: Edge Compute Mesh / Intelligence Well
features.headline: A distributed intelligence platform powered by trusted compute.
features.description: Trusted PCs, VMs, GPUs and edge devices can later contribute AI capacity into a shared orchestration network.
bullets: access more intelligence through the MMIR network

features.title: Secure AI Architecture
features.headline: Built around Zero Trust and local-first principles.
features.description: MMIR is designed around secure API layers, localhost isolation, protected backend routing and separation between frontend, secrets and runtime infrastructure.
bullets: more control over infrastructure and data

features.title: One-Click AI Deployment
features.headline: From setup to working AI in minutes.
features.description: Automate onboarding, deployment and infrastructure management so users can run advanced AI systems without deep technical knowledge.

features.title: AI Control Plane
features.headline: The orchestration layer for trusted AI.
features.description: MMIR acts as the central control plane connecting models, workflows, agents, infrastructure and intelligence sources into one unified trusted AI platform.
